sounds.name: Coin Pickup 001
sounds.description: Arcade coin pickup with a bright tail.

sounds.name: Coin Pickup 002
sounds.description: Three-note triangle arpeggio, bright coin pickup.

sounds.name: Hit Impact 001
sounds.description: Low tone with a short noise burst.

sounds.name: Explosion Small 001
sounds.description: Filtered noise with a downward low sweep.

sounds.name: Checkpoint 002
sounds.description: Three-note bell arpeggio, rewarding checkpoint validation.

sounds.name: Power Up 002
sounds.description: Continuous rising sweep with a high bell finish.

sounds.name: Chest Open 001
sounds.description: Mechanical clatter then a bright reveal chime.

sounds.name: Door Open 001
sounds.description: Wooden door creak with a low descending tone.

sounds.name: Footstep Mud Deep 001
sounds.description: Pas lourds dans une boue profonde.

sounds.name: Footstep Wood Hollow 001
sounds.description: Pas sur un plancher en bois creux.

sounds.name: Footstep Marble Hall 001
sounds.description: Pas résonnants dans un hall en marbre.

sounds.name: Footstep Snow Crust 001
sounds.description: Pas écrasant une croûte de neige.

sounds.name: Footstep Shallow Water 001
sounds.description: Pas dans de l'eau peu profonde.

sounds.name: Footstep Dry Leaves Pile 001
sounds.description: Pas dans un tas de feuilles sèches.

sounds.name: Footstep Sand Dunes 001
sounds.description: Pas sur du sable meuble de dunes.

sounds.name: Slide Stone Surface 001
sounds.description: Glissade sur une surface en pierre.

sounds.name: Slide Ice Long 001
sounds.description: Longue glissade sur de la glace.

sounds.name: Ladder Wood Climb 001
sounds.description: Montée sur une échelle en bois.

sounds.name: Heavy Landing Dirt 001
sounds.description: Atterrissage lourd sur de la terre.

sounds.name: Drawbridge Lower 001
sounds.description: Chain links pay out as a drawbridge lowers and lands on the far bank with a heavy thud.

sounds.name: Drawbridge Raise Creak 001
sounds.description: Heavy timber groans and chains strain as a drawbridge is hauled up and latches shut.

sounds.name: Portcullis Drop 001
sounds.description: An iron portcullis rattles down its grooves and slams into the ground, ringing.

sounds.name: Portcullis Ratchet Raise 001
sounds.description: A winch ratchets the portcullis upward with steady pawl clicks and a low groan.

sounds.name: Gate Bar Drop 001
sounds.description: A heavy wooden bar drops into its brackets and settles with a deep thunk.

sounds.name: Murder Hole Pour 001
sounds.description: Scalding liquid is poured from the battlements, splashing and sizzling below.

sounds.name: Longbow Twang Whoosh 001
sounds.description: A bowstring twangs, an arrow whooshes away and thuds into its target.

sounds.name: Crossbow Winch Latch 001
sounds.description: A crossbow is cocked with a ratcheting winch and the string catches on the latch.

sounds.name: Ballista Release 001
sounds.description: A giant ballista releases with a frame slam, a heavy twang and a rushing bolt.

sounds.name: Catapult Arm Swing 001
sounds.description: A catapult arm creaks under tension, whips through the air and slams into its stop.

sounds.name: Trebuchet Weight Drop 001
sounds.description: A trebuchet counterweight plunges, the rope whips and the frame groans after the impact.

sounds.name: Stone Incoming Whistle 001
sounds.description: A siege stone whistles through the sky and smashes into the ground with flying debris.

sounds.name: Battering Ram Hit 001
sounds.description: A battering ram booms against a gate, splintering the wood with a long creak.

sounds.name: Siege Ladder Clack 001
sounds.description: A siege ladder clacks against a wall, scrapes into place and wobbles.

sounds.name: Siege Tower Roll 001
sounds.description: A towering wooden siege engine rolls slowly forward with rumbling wheels and squealing axles.

sounds.name: Grapple Hook Catch 001
sounds.description: A grappling hook is thrown, clinks onto the battlement and catches as the rope draws tight.

sounds.name: War Horn Call 001
sounds.description: A watchtower war horn sounds two long notes, the second higher than the first.

sounds.name: Alarm Bell Frantic 001
sounds.description: A tower bell is struck in rapid, frantic alarm.

sounds.name: Stake Barricade Set 001
sounds.description: Sharpened wooden stakes are set into the ground one after another to form a barricade.

sounds.name: Shield Wall Lock 001
sounds.description: A line of shields slams together into a tight defensive wall.

sounds.name: Cell Bars Clang 001
sounds.description: An iron cell door clangs shut, its bars ringing with a long metallic decay.

sounds.name: Moat Heavy Splash 001
sounds.description: A large stone drops into the moat with a deep splash and rolling waves.

sounds.name: Chain Snap Whip 001
sounds.description: A siege chain strains and snaps, whipping through the air and rattling to the ground.

sounds.name: Armored Patrol March 001
sounds.description: An armored guard marches along a rampart, each step clinking with plate and mail.

sounds.name: Banner Unfurl Flap 001
sounds.description: A large banner unfurls and flaps in the wind above the walls.
